scores.evidence: Desktop is clean and well paced: figure, tables, code, steps and checks alternate and there are no text-only screens. On 390 px, though, the s2-layers diagram is cut off on the right, so the whole 'ファイル操作ツール・MCPサーバー' branch is hidden. The third column of both s2-table and s5-table (the actual countermeasures) is also pushed off-screen.

Sections are short and every screen has an anchor (heading, definitions, steps, code or a check). The practice section is long (mobile-jp-15 to -20: two code blocks, a list, three steps blocks, two prompts and a checklist), but it is broken into clear chunks.

The Japanese UI and content are consistent, with no stray English UI strings. Contrast is fine and controls clear both bars. Diagram nodes wrap awkwardly ('Webペー / ジ' in desktop-jp-04). In mobile-jp-17 an inline-code token forces the break 'Claudeは中身を読め / ず、'. Desktop measure is a median of 44 chars per line against the 30–40 target.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px the Mermaid figure is wider than the frame and cut off on the right. Labels are truncated ('README・Issue・W…', '拒否・確認・分類…', 'VM・クラウドセッション：Claud…'), and the 'ファイル操作ツール・MCPサーバー（サンドボックスの外）' node is not visible at all. That hides the figure's main point (the sandbox wraps only the shell side). On desktop, 'Webページ' breaks leaving 'ジ' alone, and the A→B arrow runs through the subgraph title.
mustFix.fix:
Narrow the graph so it fits about 340 px. Shorten the labels: A '外部の文章
README・Issue・Web', the VMBOX title 'VM：Claude Code全体を隔離', C '権限ルールと承認', D 'ファイル操作・MCP
（サンドボックス外）', E 'シェルコマンド'. Put the details ('拒否・確認・分類器') in the caption or alt text. If it is still too wide, stack D below E (for example C --> E and E ~~~ D) instead of side by side.

mustFix.issue: On mobile the third column '合う対策' (the answer the learner needs) is clipped at the right edge, and only one or two characters of each cell are visible.
mustFix.fix: Make it two columns ('場面と起きうること' / '合う対策'), or turn it into a definitions or list block with one item per scene ('外部の文章：紛れた指示に従う → 承認前に読む…'). Shorten the long cell 'ネットにつながらないコンテナやVMだけで使う' to 'オフラインのコンテナかVMだけ'.

mustFix.issue: On mobile the third column '確かめ方と対策' is cut off ('/status で確…', '作業の切れ目…'), and the first column wraps to one or two characters per line ('APIの請 / 求が届い / た').
mustFix.fix: Make it two columns ('症状と原因' / '確かめ方と対策'), or use one list item or definitions entry per symptom. Move the long asides ('（/compact はそれ自体が大きな要求）', '（effort：考える量の設定）') into the paragraph above or the glossary so the cells stay short.

niceToHave: practice-case-zshrc: on mobile the export line is cut at 'ここで…' (mobile-jp-15). Shorten the value to '"（副業用のキー）"' so it fits without scrolling.
practice-folder: on mobile line 1 'mkdir cc-practice && cd cc-practice && git init' is clipped (mobile-jp-17). Split it into three lines.
s3-code: on mobile line 4 is clipped just before the closing quote and comma (mobile-jp-10). Consider a shorter sample path such as 'Read(./config/secret.json)'.

practice-steps-deny: the expect text 'Claudeは中身を読めず、`/permissions` にルールが出ます。' breaks as '読め / ず、' on mobile (mobile-jp-17). Reword so the code token is not glued to the verb, e.g. 'Claudeは中身を読めません。ルールは `/permissions` に出ます。'

reader: the glossary panel lists each term twice ('プロンプトインジェクション（prompt injection）' and 'プロンプトインジェクション', and the same for ワークスペースの信頼 and サンドボックス) because definitions terms and glossary terms are not de-duplicated (desktop-jp-01).
reader: desktop measure is 680 px at 18.7 px, which gives a median of 44 JP chars per line against the 30–40 target (metrics.json charsPerLine).
summary: lessonHash sha256:c7223f9f160f438c matches metrics.json, there are no hard failures (no overflow, console, mermaid, unknown-block or broken-image errors), and no personal data appears on any screen. Desktop looks good: each screen carries a figure, table, code block or check. The fix that matters is mobile: the s2-layers diagram and the third column of s2-table and s5-table are cut off at 390 px, so shorten the diagram labels and make both tables two columns or lists.
